description: NSW post-fire debris flow susceptibility map is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Debris flows are extremely damaging and dangerous post-fire hazards that can cause significant short- and long-term impacts to rivers and aquatic ecosystems, water quality, and infrastructure. However, they are relatively poorly documented in NSW. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Fire Management Planning, HAZARDS-Fire, Post-fire Recovery, SOIL-Erosion, WATER-Quality. It offers 5 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, geotiff, pdf, wms. The portal shows 2025-10-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
